content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati SRF Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Mandatory qualification and experience: Qualifications as per JRF(GATE), plus 2 years of research experience in the area for the development of deep learning algorithms for real-time computer vision applications. According to the notice, the JRF(GATE) qualifications are a Post Graduate degree in basic science, or a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through any one of these processes: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Test - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DoS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISCR etc. For the full eligibility details of the post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on the candidate's performance in the interview. The interview is held online via Zoom on 4 November 2026 at 03.15 pm. The Zoom link will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is for 11 months under the project at the Mehta Family School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, IIT Guwahati.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati SRF Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati . Find the position by searching for the project title: "Interval Type-2 Fuzzy Systems Coupled Compact Single Image Dehazing Network Based Approach for Image Enhancement". Follow the instructions and guidelines on the portal carefully, and fill in the online application. Submit the application on or before 3 November 2026, 11:59 PM IST. For technical help with the online application, email [email protected] . For questions about the post, contact Teena Sharma (Principal Investigator) at [email protected] or by phone at +91-361-258-3506.

faq.question: Q1. How many SRF posts does IIT Guwahati have in this notice?
faq.answer: There is 1 post: SRF (Direct), in project No. 2627R-0151-MFSD1392TEEN.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly pay of this SRF post?
faq.answer: The recommended pay is Rs. 42,000.00, with Rs. 8,400.00 as HRA and Rs. 1,250.00 as medical allowance, which comes to Rs. 51,650.00 a month.

faq.question: Q3. How much research experience is needed?
faq.answer: You need 2 years of research experience in developing deep learning algorithms for real-time computer vision applications, along with the JRF(GATE) qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. Which exams count for the JRF(GATE) qualification?
faq.answer: CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship / Assistant Professorship) and GATE, or national-level exams held by Central Government departments and agencies such as DST, DBT, DAE, DoS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc and IISCR.

faq.question: Q5. When and how is the interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is online via Zoom on 4 November 2026 (Wednesday) at 03.15 pm. Only shortlisted candidates will get the Zoom link.

faq.question: Q6. How do I find this position on the portal?
faq.answer: Search the R&D recruitment portal for the project title "Interval Type-2 Fuzzy Systems Coupled Compact Single Image Dehazing Network Based Approach for Image Enhancement".

faq.question: Q7. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The SRF appointment is for 11 months.

faq.question: Q8. Whom do I contact if the online form gives a technical problem?
faq.answer: Email [email protected]. For questions about the post itself, contact the Principal Investigator, Teena Sharma, on +91-361-258-3506.
